# Digital Growth Labs

> Digital Growth Labs (DGL) is a digital marketing agency in Vancouver, BC. It helps local businesses across Metro Vancouver, the Fraser Valley and Vancouver Island grow online through Google Business Profile management, local SEO, Google & Meta ads, web design, social media, delivery-app management (DoorDash, Uber Eats, SkipTheDishes) and commission-free Clover online ordering.

- Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada
- Service area: Metro Vancouver, Richmond, the Fraser Valley and Vancouver Island
- Clients: restaurants, salons and spas, florists, retail, hospitality, multi-location brands, and high-ticket local businesses (sports academies, med spas, dental, auto detailing/PPF, renovators and custom builders)
- Contact: admin@digitalgrowthlabs.ca · 778-323-1804
- Free, no-obligation business audit available: https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca

DGL works as one accountable team across every channel instead of selling a single service. Every engagement starts with an audit of the business's full online presence, followed by a focused strategy, execution across channels, plain-language reporting and ongoing optimization.

## Services

- [Google Business Profile Management](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/google-business-profile): Weekly posts, photos, review replies and profile optimization to rank in the Google Maps local pack.
- [Local SEO](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/seo): Keyword research, technical fixes, content and citations for Vancouver and Lower Mainland businesses.
- [Google & Meta Ads](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/google-meta-ads): Paid search and social campaigns: strategy, creative, targeting, retargeting and transparent reporting.
- [Web Design & Development](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/web-design): Fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready small business websites, including Clover POS and online ordering integration.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/social-media): Content creation, scheduling, community engagement and monthly reporting.
- [Delivery Platform Setup](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/delivery-platforms): DoorDash, Uber Eats and SkipTheDishes onboarding, menu and photo optimization, promos and ratings management for BC restaurants.
- [Clover Online Ordering](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/services/clover-online-ordering): Commission-free online ordering on a restaurant's own website, connected to Clover POS so paid orders print straight to the kitchen.

## Industries

- [All industries](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/industries): Overview of the high-ticket local businesses DGL markets.
- [Sports Academies](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/industries/sports-academies): Golf, hockey, tennis and training centres in Vancouver and Richmond.
- [Med Spas & Aesthetic Clinics](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/industries/med-spas): Marketing planned around BC advertising standards.
- [Dental & Orthodontics](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/industries/dental): Cosmetic dentists and orthodontists (implants, veneers, Invisalign).
- [Auto Detailing & PPF](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/industries/auto-detailing): PPF, ceramic coating, wrap and detailing studios and car dealers.
- [Renovators & Custom Builders](https://www.digitalgrowthlabs.ca/industries/home-improvement): Cabinet makers, closet companies, renovators and custom home builders.
